posts.fact_source: FIP Reglamento de Juego, Regla 13.1.l (own glass allowed, own fence = point lost)

slides.q: Can you play the ball off your own fence?
slides.claim: Your shot hits your own fence, then flies over the net. The rally goes on.

slides.text: Your shot hits your own fence, then flies over the net.

scene.alt: Side view: the ball hits the player's own fence above the back glass and flies over the net

slides.line:
Own back glass: fine.
Own fence: point **lost**.

posts.caption:
Your own back glass is your friend. But what about the fence above it? 🤔

Most club players get this one wrong.

Comment FAIR or FAULT before you swipe 👇 Send it to the one who always argues.

slides.q: Is a serve that touches the net always replayed?
slides.claim: Your serve clips the net, lands in the box, then hits the fence. You serve again.

slides.line:

Only net + box is replayed.
